what_it_does: HDFC Bank sells comprehensive banking, financial, and insurance products and services to retail customers, small and mid-market enterprises, large corporates, and government entities, making money through interest income, fees, and lending services.
other_facts: HDFC Bank has an extensive network of over 8,500 branches as of March 31, 2026.
HDB Financial Services has a network of over 1,730 branches spread across 1,161 cities.
HDFC ERGO covered about 1.74 crore lives in FY 2025-26 under health insurance.
